D/ P SEPT GETA CAES PONT ; R/ PRINC IVVENTVTIS

Silver denarius of Geta (209-212) as Caesar (198-209), issue of 200, Rome mint. Two deep angled cuts appear on edge of coin at [obverse] 7 O'clock. RIC vol. 4 part 1 no. 18. Obverse description: Youthful bust draped right. Obverse inscription: P SEPT GETA CAES PONT Reverse description: Geta standing left holding baton and sceptre; trophy behind. Reverse inscription: PRINC IVVENTVTIS Diameter:…
